scope: Bounded read-only storage attribution for Gideon-owned state and canonical project roots
acceptance: Measure actual logical file bytes and entry counts only beneath captured runtime home or canonical HierarchyStore project roots
Never accept arbitrary paths, traverse symlinks, filesystem roots or mounted filesystem boundaries, and expose truthful bounded partial scans
Attribute project workspace and canonical project metadata separately without writing, deleting or cleaning any storage
Owner HTTP, native safe tool and console share the same diagnosis with real filesystem and Chromium tests
limitations: Logical attributed bytes are not filesystem allocated blocks, snapshots, caches outside Gideon home or canonical workspaces
A diagnosis is a bounded point-in-time read and may be partial under concurrent filesystem changes or its entry limit
Native macOS storage-device and external volume qualification remains outside this local Linux checkpoint
